name: Spells vs Super Large Creatures Critical Strike Table

notes.columns: Spells against Super Large Creatures: Normal attack spell vs Slaying attack spell.

rollMatchPolicy: rollMin / rollMax inclusive. Spell attacks vs super large creatures can exceed 100; bands run to 251+ and rolls above the top band clamp to it.

normal.text: The strength of your strike is not up to the challenge.

slaying.text: You warn foe of his doom with this tiny whisper of your power.

normal.text: Strike lands with little result. You had better get serious soon.

slaying.text: Foe evades much of the damage. Maybe next time.

normal.text: The beast is made of stronger stuff than you hoped.

slaying.text: Your blast scrapes along foe's shoulder hissing as it touches his skin.

normal.text: Strike glances off foe and damages his surroundings.

slaying.text: Your strike is solid and flat, foe is burned by the enchantment.

normal.text: Solid, but nowhere near a vital spot. Bruise foe's calf muscle.

slaying.text: Heavy assault yields a measure of damage to foe's leg.

normal.text: Blow is placed solidly against foe's side. His vitals are beyond reach.

slaying.text: Strike tears down foe's back. He ducks down in pain.

normal.text: Strike threatens foe's eyes and he flinches. You have initiative.

slaying.text: Blast to foe's face. Most of the damage misses him. Some does not.

normal.text: You find a weak point. Unexpectedly, foe reels and falls down. His shoulder is shattered. He gets up slowly.

slaying.text: Collapse foe's chest with perfect placement. His lungs are destroyed and his heart stops. He dies after 6 rounds of wheezing.

normal.text: Although not deadly, this strike leaves a visible and encouraging wound. You may win yet.

slaying.text: Assault bounces off foe's primary arm. Arm is damaged but still functioning. Try again.

normal.text: Blow to foe's upper arm. Discoloration and various bruises mark your success.

slaying.text: Solid strike to the chest. Foe steps back 10 feet and rebounds.

normal.text: Your strike hit no vitals, but you can hear the ribs in foe's side crackle. Foe fights on in some pain.

slaying.text: Sparks fly and smoke rises off foe as your assault impacts.

normal.text: Heavy and hard. Your strike is effective. Foe's abdomen is damaged.

slaying.text: Your attack lands with a beautiful crash. Foe's leg is heavily damaged. He struggles to keep his defense up.

normal.text: Your onslaught lands against foe's skull. Brain is damaged. Swelling fractures his skull. Foe drops and dies in 6 rounds.

slaying.text: Shot lands against foe's chest. Strike infests foe with terminal poison. The full burden of the enchantment ends his life instantly.

normal.text: Violent strike to foe's face. His eyes are badly damaged. He is blinded. He falls over. You have him now.

slaying.text: Blast to foe's head. Inner ear destroyed. Foe dies in 6 inactive rounds.

normal.text: Titanic blast sends foe stumbling despite his bulk. He is unable to defend himself for a moment.

slaying.text: Foe stumbles 10 feet to his right with the impact of your attack. He is vulnerable.

normal.text: Side strike. Foe steps to the side and takes the damage in his ribs. Bones are broken.

slaying.text: Blast breaks bones and causes bleeding in foe's leg. He can still operate.

normal.text: Mighty is your strike. It's your turn to give. Foe's chest tears open and blood sprays on all bystanders.

slaying.text: Epic assault to foe's side sends foe onto his back. Wounds are severe. Internal bleeding. He is in trouble.

normal.text: Snap foe's head back and fracture his spine. Foe is paralyzed from the neck down.

slaying.text: Hammer foe's neck and face. The energy engulfs his throat. Nerves are destroyed. Foe dies after 9 inactive rounds.

normal.text: Shatter parts of foe's skeleton. Heart and lungs are damaged. Foe falls dead. His blood pours out onto the floor.

slaying.text: Blast goes in through foe's eye and comes out ugly. Foe dies instantly. His terrible bulk comes crashing down.
